records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Vantage Media!
records.body:
Hi Owen,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 (2026-06-19) then six days of silence: no tasks, no invite sent, no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:33721df5]. Solo Starter admin with early momentum but no engagement signal; 8 days left leaves some chance of self-serve return.

draft.subject: Quick hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Owen,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks there is usually the fastest way to see whether it fits how Vantage Media works.

If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and help you map your current workflow into that first project — or just answer questions by email if that's easier.

Best,
Priya
